learning_outcomes.text: Participants have gained insight into the current state of the art of passive and active electronic components and have acquired an understanding of the fundamentals of electronics.

They have gained a profound understanding of the physical functioning of components, their description by models and equivalent circuits in suitable approximations, and their application in basic circuits.

syllabus_topics: Electronic components as basic units of electronics
Physical processes in passive and active electronic components
Basic properties of electronic materials, especially semiconductors
Functionality and characteristic curves of components
Desired and parasitic effects in components
Theoretical description by suitable equivalent circuits
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
